trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work through the roadmap in order: finish the story while watching the missable list, clear the side strands, mop up collectibles and challenges, then finish the money and property trophies. If the platinum does not pop, one trophy is still missing — use the Remaining filter to find it.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available for purchase. Property buying is a series staple: garages appear as purchasable locations on the map, each with a price. This is a late-game money trophy — save it until your income from story and robberies is steady, then buy each garage as you find it. All of them are required, so check the map for any garage icon you have not bought yet.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone. App-based vehicle services are a modern GTA feature: open the app, register a vehicle you own, and repeat until ten are registered. You will need ten vehicles of your own, so this pairs with buying garages and collecting cars for Whip It Good. Register each new vehicle as you acquire it and the count fills up on its own.
